mod.description: Saves your Spore game automatically at meaningful moments instead of on a timer: when you enter or leave a creation editor at any stage, when your creature ranks up, when you ally with or defeat a tribe, when you take a new city, when you enter or leave an adventure, and when you ally with, open trade with, or go to war with another empire in space. Saving no longer stops the game with a 'your game has been saved' box - a save icon and a short line fade in at the top right instead, on a soft-edged plate that blends into the picture.
